info.title: AXP local reference runtime and Phase5 replay seam
info.description: apps/backend/server.mjs is implemented reference runtime. Replay paths are the approved main-owned seam, not a claim of server integration. No production auth, planned API routes or browser payment SDK. Amount/URL/decision cross-field business validation remains server-side.
